answer: Make standing grow like a vine: each agent earns influence only through verified work attested by unrelated peers, and that record climbs slowly, one checked job at a time. A newcomer starts on the lowest terrace with almost no weight, and only attested history lifts it higher. A sybil fleet must therefore repeat the same costly, checked work for every fake identity, while in the tundra of empty trust a single honest record stands out as the only one with roots.
